# Underwater

Underwater is described by its own recorded input as a colourful, modern theme built around ocean vibes. That input states that the Style Settings plugin is needed to switch between its colour schemes and to apply its other tweaks.

![Underwater screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seniblue/Underwater/HEAD/uw.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Underwater"
    author: "seniblue"
    repo:   "seniblue/Underwater"
    slug:   "underwater"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/underwater"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/seniblue/Underwater"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seniblue/Underwater/HEAD/uw.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "A colorful and modern theme with ocean-vibes! Install the Style Settings plugin to switch color schemes and other tweaks."
}
```
